pp_v1_01_xor_single_byte.description:
A short message was encrypted by XOR-ing every byte of the plaintext with the SAME single unknown byte key. The result is given below as lowercase hex. The plaintext is a flag that starts with the five characters `flag{` and ends with `}`; the inner part is 16 lowercase hex characters.

ciphertext_hex = 3c363b3d216d3e3f6968683f68683f69636339686f27

Recover the plaintext flag. Submit it exactly, wrapped in flag{...}.
pp_v1_01_xor_single_byte.name: pp_v1_01_xor_single_byte

pp_v1_02_rsa_low_exponent_cube.description:
An RSA key uses a small public exponent and, crucially, no padding. You are given the modulus, the exponent and one ciphertext. The message integer m was small enough that m^e did not wrap around the modulus.

n = 71452157763197317592333732103635479560623840255742592804197961701944226483533
e = 3
c = 143883482714523036559148117399459490747415092559826448500042612627718856

Recover m. The flag is `flag{` + the lowercase hexadecimal representation of m (no leading zeros) + `}`.
pp_v1_02_rsa_low_exponent_cube.name: pp_v1_02_rsa_low_exponent_cube

pp_v1_03_vigenere_known_key.name: pp_v1_03_vigenere_known_key

pp_v1_04_lcg_predict_next.description:
A service generates session identifiers with a linear congruential generator. The recurrence and modulus are public, only the initial state is secret:

    x_{i+1} = (a * x_i + c) mod m
    a = 48271
    c = 11
    m = 2147483647

Four consecutive outputs (x_1 .. x_4) were observed:

    x_1 = 1737261445
    x_2 = 110796256
    x_3 = 1011792357
    x_4 = 8281037

Predict x_5. The flag is `flag{` + the 8-digit lowercase hexadecimal representation of x_5, zero padded + `}`.
pp_v1_04_lcg_predict_next.name: pp_v1_04_lcg_predict_next

pp_v1_05_weak_seed_prng.description:
A token generator seeds Python's `random.Random(seed)` with a small integer seed in the range 0 <= seed <= 999999 and then emits `randrange(10**9)` values. Four consecutive outputs are known:

    out_1 = 125869508
    out_2 = 126662829
    out_3 = 433115555
    out_4 = 461148702

Find the seed and report it as the flag: `flag{` + the decimal seed + `}`. (The fifth output is not needed; the seed alone is the answer.)
pp_v1_05_weak_seed_prng.name: pp_v1_05_weak_seed_prng

pp_v1_06_encoding_nest.description:
A challenge author encoded the flag with four layers applied in this exact order, each consuming the previous output as raw bytes:

    1. ROT13 over lowercase ASCII letters only
    2. hex encoding of the resulting bytes
    3. Base32 (RFC 4648, standard alphabet, with padding)
    4. Base64 (standard alphabet, with padding)

The final blob is:

RzRaVE9PSldNVTNUSU4zQ0dNWVRHT0pUR01aVFFNWlVHTVpER09CVEdZWlRPTVpXRzVTQT09PT0=

Reverse the pipeline and submit the flag.
pp_v1_06_encoding_nest.name: pp_v1_06_encoding_nest

pp_v1_07_licence_constraints.description:
A licence checker reads an 8 digit code d0 d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 (each a single decimal digit) and accepts it only when ALL of the following constraints hold:

    d0 * d1 == 32
    d0 + d1 == 12
    d1 > d0
    d2 * d3 == 14
    d2 < d3
    d4 + d5 == 6
    d4 * 2 + d5 == 7
    d6 + d7 == 9
    d7 == 2 * d6

The system is consistent and has exactly one solution. Find the accepted code and submit it as `flag{` + the 8 digits + `}`.
pp_v1_07_licence_constraints.name: pp_v1_07_licence_constraints

pp_v1_08_discrete_log_small.description:
A small Diffie-Hellman style parameter set leaked. You know the prime, the generator and one public value, and you need the private exponent.

    p = 1000003
    g = 5
    y = g^x mod p = 979732

The exponent x is smaller than p. Recover x and submit it as `flag{` + the decimal value of x + `}`.
pp_v1_08_discrete_log_small.name: pp_v1_08_discrete_log_small

pp_v1_09_ctr_nonce_reuse.description:
An encryption service reuses the same AES-CTR keystream for two different plaintexts (the nonce was never incremented). You captured both ciphertexts, and you also know the exact content of the first plaintext from a debug log.

    plaintext_A = session=guest;user=alice;role=viewer;ok=1
    ciphertext_A = 58b31abe7b92b6cc5716df1bfd7164d8aa8419bb16bd3274fcd49bbb46ad21aa40d9028b1fcba385e3
    ciphertext_B = 4dba08aa699cbbc70852d95bbd7829caff8b

plaintext_B is the flag. Recover it. Note that ciphertext_B is shorter than ciphertext_A, so only part of the keystream was used for B.
pp_v1_09_ctr_nonce_reuse.name: pp_v1_09_ctr_nonce_reuse

pp_v1_10_rsa_common_modulus.description:
The same RSA message was encrypted twice under the same modulus but with two different public exponents, and both ciphertexts were captured. No padding was used.

    n  = 1132034722156551006219009010019895241096472734450123623970333012472031681782736305773230200240617
    e1 = 3
    c1 = 43935304231313707758693396911770170562283853823543965629
    e2 = 17
    c2 = 1077559906443806114796833408779500725157824003840631793531165625841460260536775992012913300843188

Recover m. The flag is `flag{` + the lowercase hexadecimal representation of m (no leading zeros) + `}`.
pp_v1_10_rsa_common_modulus.name: pp_v1_10_rsa_common_modulus

audit.design_note: 单字节 XOR 暴力（按 flag 形态剪枝）
RSA e=3 无填充小消息，整数立方根
Vigenere 已知密钥，字母前进/非字母不变
LCG 参数公开，迭代预测下一状态
ROT13 → hex → Base32 → Base64 四层逆序
8 位校验码约束系统求解（唯一解）
AES-CTR nonce 复用，两密文 XOR 消 keystream
RSA 共模攻击（e1=3, e2=17，扩展欧几里得）

known_limitations: 自造题只证明「链路可解 + 系统能解出结构完整的题」，不能外推为对公开赛题未见过题目的泛化能力
题目难度由出题方设定，非赛题分布抽样，不构成难度校准
provenance.note: 10 道本项目原创私有题，材料 100%% 内嵌题面（零附件依赖），flag 明文不由任何文件保存（种子 sha256 派生），生成时逐题机验「仅凭题面可解」。
